notes.title: Torchlight: Infinite - "Sandlord" Season
notes.content:
[h2]The Sandlord Season arrives alongside the Torchlight: Infinite 2nd Anniversary! [/h2]
Prepare for a massive update featuring the new Cloud Oasis seasonal mechanic, the powerful Blending system, Thea's dark Blasphemer Trait, major endgame overhauls, tons of QoL, and huge anniversary rewards!

[b]Season Launch Date[/b]: April 17 at 07:00 PM PDT

[b]New Gameplay and Content[/b]:
[*][b]New Seasonal Mechanic: Sandlord[/b]
Claim your own floating island in the Netherrealm! Gather resources, recruit workers to craft valuable trade goods, and forge alliances (or rivalries) with other islands to build your fortune.
Raid for Riches: Assemble a mercenary squad and plunder hidden treasures from rival sand pirates. Beware deadly encounters and unearth powerful, rare relics! Expand your island into a thriving trade hub as you venture deeper into the Netherrealm.

[*][b]New Growth Mechanic: Blending Rituals[/b]
Upgrade your Blending Building and complete missions to unlock Blending Recipes. Craft unique affixes for your belt equipment, enhancing your build in powerful new ways.
Unlock Over 100 Blending Recipes: Discover recipes for Intermediate Talents, Primary/Secondary Talent Big Points, Hero Traits, and hidden affixes. Gain early-game advantages and deep endgame customization to create truly unique characters.

[*][b]New Hero Trait: Thea - Blasphemer[/b]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42897432/fb86b3e10e16207e9d370cdecf67600e076ee686.jpg[/img]
Once blessed, Thea now treads a darker path. Abandoning her divine gifts, she twists their power into Desecration – a potent curse inflicting escalating Erosion Damage on a single foe. The weaker her blessings, the stronger the Desecration!

[b]New Events[/b]:
[b]Anniversary Login Event[/b]
Log in during the celebration to receive a treasure trove of rewards, including:
[*]One Legendary Pactspirit 
[*]Blasphemer Weapon Skin for Thea
[*]Exclusive Anniversary Portrait & Frame
[*]Battle Pactspirit Crystal x20
[*]Rare Pactspirits and Upgrade Emblems

[b]Sands of Fortune[/b]
[*]Join the gold rush! Complete in-game tasks to earn chances to strike it rich. Every dig guarantees valuable in-game items, with a lucky few winning the exclusive Torchlight Anniversary commemorative gold banknote!


For an in-depth overview of what's coming, here Is our official Season Preview!

notes.content:
[h2]Event Announcement[/h2]

[h3]Anniversary Celebration[/h3]
Thank you, for your continued support of Torchlight: Infinite. During the anniversary celebration, Hunters only need to log in for a total of 7 days to receive all the event rewards, which include: Back accessory: Underwater Operation, 150 Jagged Primocrysts, 2 Outfit Boon Discount Coupons, 300 Jagged Primocrysts, 5 Pactspirit Crystals, 3 Outfit Boon Discount Coupons, and 1 Legendary Battle Pactspirit Selection Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897432/6b1490b866c6ca04e094d257e6c38912accdc495.jpg[/img]

[h3]First Top-up Double Reset[/h3]
The top-up in the shop will be reset to Bonus X2 status after the new season begins.

[h3]Mistville Mysteries[/h3]
-- Introducing the Whispering Mist Season Series event! Transform into a Mistville detective, accept commissions, and win abundant rewards from the Mistville Detective Agency.

Accept Commissions: Hunters have a chance to obtain the event item "Commission Letter" while fighting in the Netherrealm. Collecting Commission Letters can be exchanged for various rewards at the Mistville Detective Agency, such as Pactspirit: First Mate of the Furious Sea - Silent Night, Pactspirit Crystal, Pactspirit Crystal - Battle, Portrait: Rainbow Player, and Jona Tax Voucher - Flame Elementium, etc.

Interview & Investigate: By completing the quest objectives in the Interview & Investigate section, Hunters can earn event points. Based on the accumulated number of points, Hunters can obtain rewards such as Pactspirit Crystals - Battle, Body Outfit Special Effects: Rainbow Glider, Outfit Boon Discount Coupons, and more.

Investigate Evidence: Hunters have a chance to obtain the event item "Key Evidence" while battling in the Netherrealm. Collecting Key Evidence can be exchanged for various rewards at the Mistville Detective Agency, such as Teleport effect: Proton Core, Pactspirit Crystal - Battle, and Jona Tax Voucher - Flame Elementium, etc.

Mistville Detective Agency: Hunters can use the collected Commission Letters and Key Evidence to exchange for rewards here. They can also exchange special rewards "Detective's Treasure" through the "Detective's Journal". Upon opening the treasure, players can obtain Aura skill effects: Peculiar Pixel and Pactspirit Crystal - Battle x5, among other rewards.

[h3]Legendary Vision[/h3]
- Hunters can choose 5 items from the non-exclusive Rare Legendary Gear pool to increase their drop weight. Each wish is only valid for 24 hours, and a new wish must be made after it expires. Popular high-priced Legendary Gear in the Trade House will be automatically marked as hot and listed in the front row at regular intervals to help hunters make their selection.

New outfits are now available for direct purchase in the shop, and will remain as regular items after their release. Enjoy a 20% discount for the first three weeks after the release. Torchlight hunters, the wait is over! The new season, "Whispering Mist," will officially be available on April 18th at 7pm PDT.

👁️ Whispering Mist 👁️

In the new season, hunters can obtain Infection Progress by defeating Mistville Residents and proceed to Mistville through the Mistville Trader to become a mist detective, experiencing a series of bizarre and mysterious folklore events. After completing the folklore challenges, hunters will have a chance to obtain the mysterious item of this season - "Activation Medium"!

👁️ New Support Skill: Activation Medium 👁️

Activation Medium is a new type of support skill added in the Whispering Mist season. It can help hunters automatically trigger active skills and even bring additional special effects to active skills. In the new season, different Activation Mediums have different effects and trigger conditions, allowing every hunter the opportunity to free their hands!

👁️ New Trait: Lightning Shadow 👁️

The cat generator is here! With the help of Ember technology, Lightning Shadow Erika runs with sparks and lightning, gaining faster movement speed and higher damage! She can record the highest shock damage dealt within a certain period into her homemade "Feline Figure," which has a chance to appear when Erika hits an enemy, shocking all enemies within range!

👁️ Important Optimization 👁️

Multiple optimization items are now live, addressing pain points: Build codes and filter codes are now cross-server compatible, Help manual iteration, early game process acceleration, one-click pick up for stackable items of the same type, free trial of all hero traits when purchasing a manual... Crow is working hard to bring hunters a better experience!

For more details, please check: [url=https://torchlight.xd.com/en/news/single?id=w2fksu9BgFUo] Whispering Mist Season Patch Notes [/url]

notes.title: Team-up mode is now available!

tags.feature: The team-up feature is available. This gameplay mode is [b]a trial version only available in the Preseason server[/b]. We welcome hunters to try it out and share their experiences and feedback with us in the community.
Hunters can form two-person teams in the Netherrealm (including Plane Watchers and Travelers of The Realms); the Hunter who creates the team will be the team leader;
The team leader can change the distribution method at any time, which will notify team members in real-time but will not affect items that have already dropped;

Team Distribution: The right to pick up dropped items will be automatically rotated among the team members in the current stage. If an item is not picked up for more than 2 minutes, or the person eligible to pick it up leaves the stage, the right to pick it up will be given to all team members (excluding those who entered the stage after the item dropped);

System Distribution: The right to pick up dropped items will be automatically rotated among the team members in the current stage. When the person eligible to pick up an item leaves the stage, the right to pick it up will be given to all team members (excluding those who entered the stage after the item dropped);
Free Distribution: The right to pick up dropped items will be automatically given to all team members in the current stage when the item drops;
The cost of opening a stage (such as beacons or tickets) will be borne only by the team leader, and team members do not need to bear it;
In team-up mode, the number of team members affects the drop bonus, which is slightly increased, and the XP bonus is slightly increased, but the Max Life of monsters will have an additional bonus.
In team-up mode, only the team leader can enter the Nightmare map in the Nightmare gameplay. We will optimize this rule in the future.

[h3]Invincible Champion Special Mechanism:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gladiator: Inspired by the God of War, rare monsters in stages have a chance to upgrade to various Gladiators, all of which are gilded in gold. The rarest Gold Gladiator will come with its own arena, where hunters must duel it. Defeating a Gladiator can yield very generous loot and special buffs.

notes.title: [Crow's Letter] Note about Preseason "Invincible Champion"
notes.content:
Dear Torchlight Hunters,.

[b]We have carefully read all your discussions and requests about the preseason, and Dev team has also seriously browsed your suggestions and feelings and held discussions. In the end, we will respond to your requests and make corresponding adjustments to the preseason.[/b]

[h3]Regarding the Nightmare gameplay in the preseason[/h3]
Initially, we decided to close the "Twinightmare" season-exclusive gameplay in the "Invincible Champion" preseason, mainly considering that hunters have just experienced the Twinightmare season. If the preseason comes again, it may lead to a repetitive experience without freshness. We received a lot of feedback on this point during the last preseason "Hunter's Odyssey", where many hunters thought that it would be more troublesome and boring to brush through the repetitive "City of Aeterna" in the preseason. In addition, the "Invincible Champion" preseason itself has its own "Gladiator" mechanism. The Gladiator mechanism not only brings more difficult challenges but also has considerable rewards. Combined with the true triple drop rate adjustment in this preseason, we decided not to open the Twinightmare gameplay in the preseason.
However, after the announcement, we found that everyone loves the Nightmare gameplay and recognizes the drop benefits it brings. [b]After discussion, we decided to keep the "Twinightmare" season-exclusive gameplay in the "Invincible Champion" preseason, consistent with the current official season.
[/b]
[h3]Will Corgi Fighter No.32 continue to be usable?[/h3]
The answer is yes. The "Invincible Champion" preseason will still have a chance to encounter the Star of Calamity Boss, and the Star of Calamity Boss and Gladiator will coexist. The legendary drop Pactspirit "Corgi Fighter No.32", which can increase the Star of Calamity's benefits, will continue to play a role in the preseason. Of course, the Boon event "Vicious Hound Inside" where you can get Corgi Fighter No.32 will also return in the preseason.

[h3]What is the core gameplay of the "Invincible Champion" preseason?[/h3]
If the keywords of the last preseason were "Movement Speed" and "Fast Farming", then the keywords of the Gladiator mechanism this preseason might be "Skill Area" and "Siege". We will introduce more core systems and gameplay in detail later, so please look forward to it. At the same time, this preseason will add Hardcore Mode and Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode. Confident hunters can try to push their limits - however, it is important to emphasize that the strength of the Gladiator may surpass the Star of Calamity, with a very high siege difficulty. If hunters encounter both the Star of Calamity and Gladiator in Hardcore Mode, please pay great attention to survival.

[b]Thanks to all the hunters for your support and love over the past few seasons. Without your support, Torchlight: Infinite would not have come this far, nor would it have continued through seasons. In the future, we will consider and design more from hunters' perspective when designing related content, constantly bringing you a better gaming experience.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897432/93eecad9714168fbedb2f65495a12913ea5ce046.png[/img]
[h3]Spring Festival Event "Dragon Celebration" goes live[/h3]
In addition, we will start the second round of the Spring Festival Event as soon as possible. By collecting the drop  "Dragon Roar Firecrackers", [b]you can exchange for "Appearance Crystal", "Pactspirit Crystal", and "Jona Tax Voucher - Flame Elementium" and other materials. Moreover, "Jona Tax Voucher - Flame Elementium" can be exchanged without limits - the more you farm, the more you get![/b]

[b]On the occasion of the arrival of the 2024 Spring Festival, we wish all hunters a happy new year of the Dragon, Good luck in the New Year![/b]

notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yQXTstFvcAI

[i][b]In the distant Epoch of War, within the gleaming Eternal Coliseum, a warrior named Ralph brandished his sharp blade, stood alone against a legion of formidable foes and remained undefeated in the fray. To this day, the Epoch of War has long since passed, yet the spirit of valiant bravery and fearless defiance against formidable foes continues to shine like gold.

Warrior, vanquish the countless foes in the Netherrealm, march towards the center of the Eternal Coliseum, and claim the supreme rewards for the Invincible Champion![/b][/i]

[h2]Preseason: Invincible Champion will officially start on February 22nd at 18:00 (PST)![/h2]

[h3]🏆 What is "Preseason"?[/h3]
"Preseason" is an independent mini-season that takes place between official seasons. It has its own season theme, and according to this theme, there will be corresponding special mechanisms, events, and rules. The theme of this preseason is "Invincible Champion" and there will be various special mechanics and featured events revolving around this theme during the preseason.

[h3]🏆 How to participate in the "Preseason"?[/h3]
Before February 22nd, we will release a new client. Hunters who want to participate in the preseason can go to the official platform to download and install the client in advance. After the preseason server opens at February 22nd at 18:00 (PST), hunters who use this client can choose the “Invincible Champion” Preseason Server when creating a character to participate in the preseason.

[h3]🏆 What will happen to the data after the "Preseason" ends?[/h3]
The "Invincible Champion" Preseason is expected to last one month. After that, It's important to note that all character data will be deleted and not retained in the permanent server. However, the account-level rewards in the Season Pass will be sent to the account via mail.

[h3]🏆 Will there be special paid content in the "Preseason"?[/h3]
The "Invincible Champion" Preseason has an exclusive Season Pass, priced the same as the official season's Season Pass. If you purchase the Golden Season Pass for the preseason and level up to the specified level, you will be able to get the SS4 Golden Season Pass for free when the next official season SS4 starts! In addition, there are half-price booth tab and preseason-exclusive Pactspirits.

[h3]🏆 What are the unique features of the "Preseason"?[/h3]
Inspired by the God of War, rare monsters within the stage have a chance to Level Up into Bronze Gladiators, Silver Gladiators, or even the exceedingly Rare Gold Gladiators. Every time the Hunter defeats a Gladiator monster, their physique becomes enlarged and damage gets bonus. Of course, there will still be preseason-exclusive unique legendary gear for hunters to loot.

[h3]🏆 Special Note[/h3]
[list]
[*] Due to the presence of Gladiators, the overall difficulty of this Preseason may be higher. Hunters, please be extremely cautious when battling against them.
[*] To ensure a good battle experience in this preseason, the "Twinightmare" season-exclusive gameplay will not be available during preseason.
[/list]
[h3]Detailed features will be revealed for hunters later![/h3]

notes.title: [Dev Blog #27] What We're Doing to Improve the Game
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters of Torchlight!
 
It's been more than a month since the start of the Black-sail season, and we've seen that many Hunters have already overcome the Lord of the Void Sea, the most difficult challenge of the game, which means it's time for us to spend more energy on enriching the gameplay content.
 
We are very sorry that the experience of the game this season wasn't as good as expected. We will reflect on this deeply and make changes. We urgently need to enhance quality control for the version, adjust the game's balance, and improve response and processing speed when issues arise. Although many people on my team are veteran players of ARPG games who have played many similar games, it's the first time for many of them to actually use the UE4 engine to make a game with such complex data types and such a high degree of freedom.
 
But this is only the second season of Torchlight: Infinite and we're confident that everything will be improved in the updates we'll roll out in upcoming seasons. Naturally, we'll need the support, company, and feedback of all our Hunters.
 
We're now focusing on developing the next season, so we'll resolve the problems we couldn't fix in the Black-sail season in the new season. We'll also try our best to improve the game experience in the new season.
 
[h3]【Game Content】[/h3]
Although we set the duration of each season to be about three months, there hasn't been enough actual gameplay content to support this period of time. So in addition to adding new gameplay content, we're also considering extending the progression cycle and providing more goals. Naturally, if the progression curve changes, we'll also adjust the corresponding stage difficulty curve.
[list]
[*]One example is that we may adjust the crafting system to make it more exciting to make gear. At the same time, it'll also become more expensive to craft late and end-game gear.
[*]Another example is that we may adjust the difficulty of Netherrealm Timemark 8 when using a relevant compass in the new season to increase the difficulty and benefits at the same time.
[/list]
[h3]【Loot Experience】[/h3]
We've noticed that everyone seems to have been too focused on grinding Flame Fuel this season. At first, we did want to give more Flame Fuel drops to give everyone a more stable drop experience and the feeling of always getting something, with the additional effect of making it easier for everyone to learn and try out the crafting system, which would help players pick up the game faster.

However, this made the progression and drop experience of the whole season too monotonous, which is not that desirable for a loot-based ARPG. For the next season, we may add more crafting base material drops. These materials will be particularly important in the new crafting season mentioned above. Of course, we need to design corresponding filter prompts to help players recognize the corresponding gear quickly.
 
[h3]【Other Optimizations】[/h3]
We've been working on optimizations and developing new contents at the same time. The following are optimizations we plan to launch in the new season.
 
[b]Control experience:[/b]
[list]
[*]More skill casting settings and options, such as auto-channel, auto-aim, and instant cast, will be supported. These options can be enabled or disabled according to players' own control habits.
[*]Controllers will support more interfaces, and it'll be possible to call out the navigation wheel and customize it.
[*]Pactspirits will support the saving and switching of different point allocations and bonding schemes. However, it'll only be possible to adjust and switch Pactspirit builds in the Hideout, and the adjusted build will only take effect the next time a new battlefield is opened (which means players cannot change their Pactspirit build in the battlefield or by changing their Pactspirit build in the Hideout and returning to the battlefield)
[/list]
[b]PC version:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Inventory interface will support a floating UI feature. Instead of clicking on a piece of gear to view its information, the information of the gear will appear as floating text when the mouse hovers over it.
[*]Some graphic materials will be processed in HD.
[*]Changed some UI into windows. For example, other interfaces will no longer be blocked when displaying the information of two equipped One-Handed weapons and one weapon in the Inventory.
[/list]
[b]Trade House:[/b]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to conduct advanced searches for the same affixes in the Trade House. For example, it is now possible to search for a Chaotic Ending with two or three "Max Tenacity Stacks +1."
[*]We've been paying attention to everyone's feedback on the trade tax and actively increasing the distribution of Tax Refund Vouchers. We issued Tax Refund Vouchers as rewards in the Special Hunter Training event that was recently held and will distribute more Tax Refund Vouchers in the future. For example, the more times you farm Timemark 8, the more Tax Refund Vouchers you will be able to get, or you may get more Tax Refund Vouchers when your second or third character reaches a certain level in the current season... We want to minimize the impact of the tax on normal active Hunters to make everyone's experience better.
[/list]
[b]Visual experience:[/b]
We will add an option to adjust the transparency of skill effects to provide better protection for Hunters' eyes.
 
[b]Netherrealm gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]It will be possible to collect cards faster in the Chaos Invasion gameplay to allow Hunters to use more card strategies.
[*]It will be possible to end God of War early before the countdown ends if all rewards have been claimed.
[/list]
 
[b]Hunter Profile: [/b]The Hunter Profile (including Hunter Profiles opened in the Hero Ranking) will show more specific information, such as the specific talent allocations, skill connections, Pactspirit info, etc.
 
[b]Hero Emblem:[/b] From the next season, Hunters will be able to obtain up to 100 Hero Emblems, which will allow Hunters to try out more Hero Traits.
 
Of course, we're working on far more than this. We're already developing the content for the next season or even the season after that in an orderly manner. Planning and developing the content of the next few versions in advance allows us to deal with emergencies more calmly and arrange more time to verify and optimize the game.
 
As we intend to keep this game running healthily for a long time, the seasonal system and improvements are key to maintaining the vitality of the game. Although Torchlight: Infinite has just started, with the support of all the Hunters, we're confident that we'll be able to keep improving the game through the seasons. Please continue to support and share your suggestions with us. Thank you!

notes.title: [Dev Blog #22] Dark Surge & Next Season News!
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters of Torchlight!

It has now been a month since the open beta of Torchlight: Infinite started. Although there were no extreme or major incidents, a series of small twists and turns and abnormal issues still caught us by surprise. Now that things have settled down in this version, we finally have time to share with you what has happened during this period of time through this developer's blog. At the same time, We will also address some issues that have generated more feedback from the community recently.

 
[b]Update Principles[/b]

After the launching of Torchlight: Infinite, we've followed three principles with regard to the update frequency:

1. We roll out major updates on a seasonal basis, mainly to balance and adjust important systems such as skills, gear, heroes, talents, and drops.
2. We fix general bugs and errors on a weekly basis, which is why we usually have routine weekly maintenance.
3. We locate and fix urgent errors as soon as possible. For example, there was an error with the Ignite-related affixes earlier, which allowed Hunters to enter an abnormal invincible state. After locating the cause of such issues and making sufficient preparations, we will take down the server and implement a solution immediately to avoid giving everyone a bad gaming experience.

These three update principles should help you understand why updates were implemented so frequently around October 21.

- On October 19, we carried out the routine weekly maintenance.
- The event, Savage Shadows, started on October 20.
- An emergency server maintenance was implemented on October 20 to fix the invincibility issue caused by the problems with the Ignite affixes.
- An emergency server maintenance was implemented on October 21 to fix the invincibility issue caused by the problems with the Wilt affixes (similar to the Ignite affix the day before). However, when the maintenance was almost over, we realized that an art resource of the Savage Shadows event had been accidentally lost due to the update. As this would cause the game to crash abnormally, we extended the maintenance time to solve this issue.
- On October 22, some PC players were unable to enter the game. we managed to fix this issue with a 1-hour hotfix.

Upon reviewing the situation, we noted that the routine maintenance and several emergency maintenance events had collided. The frequent server shutdowns and maintenance during this time have obviously affected everyone's gaming experience to a certain extent. In the future, we will devise better plans to fix issues with abnormal affixes and try to implement such fixes in routine maintenance.

With regard to the build balance issues that everyone has reported, we have started working on the adjustments, but we will not implement any changes until the next season when everyone restarts because we don't want to affect the stability of the trading ecosystem in this season and don't want all your efforts so far to be in vain. Of course, we'll verify and tweak all changes internally and in a small beta server first.

 
[b]Handling of Violations[/b]

We've handed out a lot of mutes and bans recently. The main reasons for the bans are as follows:
1. Using third-party botting tools to play the game automatically or earn profit.
2. Using an unauthorized channel to top up or gain unjust enrichment through the rules of third-party platforms (such as by committing credit card fraud by making malicious refunds).

We made the decision to release the Trade feature after many rounds of internal evaluation and with great determination, mainly to facilitate communication between Hunters and build a dynamic and vibrant game environment. However, we firmly disapprove profit-making activities through this feature. Please do not underestimate our determination to crack down on script-based profit-making activities and offline transactions.

Unauthorized channels mainly refer to the "use of stolen credit cards." If you take a little time to learn about this, you will know that the use of such credit cards is regarded as a gray economy practice in most countries and is not protected or supported by law. Topping up in the game in this manner doesn't generate any income for the developer. It's just like buying an item with counterfeit money—the transaction will be terminated and the item will be sent back once the seller receives the counterfeit money. The only people who benefit from this process are those who provide these services. Therefore, we call on all Hunters to not top up through unauthorized third-party channels. Remember to protect your account and property.

Of course, if you have any disputes about a ban, you can contact Player Service to appeal the ban. Our Player Service colleagues will help you as soon as possible.

 
[b]New Season[/b]

Now let's talk about something everyone is probably more interested in --- the new season. We're working hard on the next season's content, and the theme is "pirates" and "plunder" related. We will launch at least one new hero and two new traits for existing heroes, as well as a batch of new skills and Legendary gears.

At the same time, we'll also bring many optimizations to the game. We've received a lot of feedback about the UI of the PC version and have heard everyone's strong desire for the support of controllers. We'll do our best to implement these two improvements in the next season. However, about adding a multiplayer mode, it will still take some time for us to develop.

The last part of this log is a Q&A session.

 
[b]FAQ[/b]

[b]Q: You keep releasing paid events but take forever to implement bug fixes and improvements. Why is that?[/b]

A: As paid events have been planned a long time ago, it doesn't take up much of our development time. As long as it is developed and configured in advance, it will automatically start at the configured time. We mostly focus on the production of the new version and improvements for the current version, but as these two things are being carried out simultaneously, many improvements and adjustments involving underlying layers of the game will be launched in the next season, so please rest assured.

[b]Q: What will happen to the players who used the bug to get Flame Elementium earlier?[/b]

A: Maybe you've seen a screenshot of an Inventory with many stacks of 999 Flame Elementium. Such images are obviously edited. We have carefully checked all the settings and codes related to drops and can confirm that there are no related issues. If you want to see Flame Elementium dropping everywhere on the ground, you can check out the "Chaos and Invasion" gameplay guide shared by other Hunters. Using a reasonable combination of cards can improve your farming efficiency. Combine that with a little luck and the God of Might will give you great rewards.

[b]Q: When will S1 end? What will happen to the account data after the season ends?[/b]

A: S1 is expected to end in January, and the new season is also scheduled to start in January. All your unlocked heroes, hero traits, Pactspirits, and appearances will carry over to the next season. They count as the shared assets of your account, so they can be used by all characters you create in the same account. However, this only applies when they are on the same server. For example, all characters created on the US server can only use assets of the account that are on the US server. Other things like Season Passes and Auction Booth Tabs will expire at the end of the season and will need to be repurchased in the new season. The characters of the Incoming Dark Surge season will be transferred to the permanent server after the new season starts. Hunters will need to create a new character to participate in the challenges of the new season.

[b]Q: Lethal Flash and Frostbitten Heart can be exchanged with Hero Emblems in the next season. Then how can we get Thea, who is unlocked in the Season Pass, in the next season?[/b]

A: In the next season, Thea can be purchased with Primocryst. And in the season after that, Thea will be able to be exchanged with Hero Emblems.

 
That's all for this developer's log. We encourage you to share your thoughts and feedback with us through our communities, especially Discord. Torchlight: Infinite is still in the open beta phase, and we will continue to optimize and improve the game based on your suggestions and feedback. Please help us make it a better ARPG and witness the transformation of Torchlight: Infinite.

notes.title: Torchlight Server Maintenance - October 19
notes.content:
Dear Torchlight Hunter:
Ember's Rest Hideout is scheduled to undergo maintenance from 21:00 to 23:00 (UTC+8) on October 19. This update will fix bugs and optimize the game, as detailed below.

I. Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the bug where tips on Back Accessories could not be viewed as expected in Season Pass
2. Fixed the bug in Chapter 4: Deserted Cave where Boss refreshes may cause the stage to be blocked
3. Fixed the bug where Netherrealm would crash in some cases
4. Fixed the bug where continuous tapping would cause abnormality
5. Fixed the bug where the chat system might not be able to assign players to channels properly
6. Fixed the bug where Thundercloud could not be released when the player is equipped with a cane
7. Fixed the bug where players could not be redirected to Thea's outfits from the event page
8. Fixed the bug where players could not log in as expected under certain network environment
9. Fixed some SFX bugs
10. Fixed the bug where Jagged Primocryst consuming quests in Season Pass could not be completed as expected in some cases
11. Fixed the bug where the free Corrosion quest in Season Pass could not be completed as expected in some cases
12. Fixed the bug where Account Recover did not work properly in some cases
13. Fixed the bug where the teleport point for Chapter 1: Ancient Battleground could not be activated
14. Fixed the bug where the red dot notification of the Exchange could not vanish as expected
15. Fixed the wrong Revival Point for Netherrealm Timemark 6: Gallery of Stars
16. Fixed the bug where gears could not be changed in Free Corrosion
17. Fixed the bug in the PC version where pressing the K key in the Shop screen of the skill screen and then returning to the main screen would cause all UI to disappear
18. Fixed the bug where changing gears might cause abnormal damage

II. Optimizations
1. Optimized the display of quest buttons in dialogues
2. Enabled the Outfit Boon feature at level 1
3. Optimized the description of drop rates in the Boons to make the rules clearer (without any adjustment of the probability)

III. New Content
1. Added the world map tutorial for beginners

That was all the update coming to Torchlight: Infinite on October 19. Thank you for your patience.
